exam.label: Exam-ready
exam.description: Two co-narrators share the facts like a Hindi exam-prep podcast.

roles.name: Kabir
roles.style: a warm, grounded co-narrator of an Indian exam-prep podcast, confident, brisk, lets big moments land with a pause
roles.look: a friendly Indian man in his thirties, short beard, round glasses, plain dark kurta, calm smile

roles.name: Tara
roles.style: a bright, sharp co-narrator of the same podcast, crisp and to the point; short acknowledgements sound natural and quick
roles.look: a cheerful Indian woman in her late twenties, hair tied back, simple collared shirt, curious expression

documentary.label: Documentary
documentary.description: One storyteller narrator, Vox / Veritasium style: history, suspense, reveals.

roles.name: Narrator
roles.style: a seasoned documentary storyteller, calm and gripping, builds suspense, lets reveals land with a pause

story.label: Story
story.description: A cinematic story built from your idea: a hero, a mentor, a rival, and a world where every concept is real.

roles.name: Narrator
roles.style: an epic film trailer and storybook narrator: warm, weighty, lets moments breathe

roles.name: Hero
roles.style: the young hero of the story, earnest and quick, asks what an examiner would ask

roles.name: Mentor
roles.style: the wise mentor of the story, calm and witty, explains in short vivid bursts

roles.name: Rival
roles.style: the story's rival or villain, cool and menacing, speaks rarely and precisely

interview.label: Interview
interview.description: A curious host interviews an expert who explains with stories and examples.

roles.name: Host
roles.style: a sharp, friendly interviewer who asks the questions the audience is thinking, briefly, and never repeats the answer back
roles.look: a friendly Indian interviewer in their thirties, smart casual, attentive expression

roles.name: Expert
roles.style: a deeply knowledgeable expert who answers with stories, analogies and precise facts
roles.look: a warm, grey-haired Indian professor, spectacles, cotton shirt, thoughtful smile
